node.subject: english
node.title: 可持续发展
node.summary: 能用英语讨论可持续发展
node.content_req: 在第三学段 (5~6 年级)教学情境中,能用英语讨论可持续发展。
key_points: 能用英语讨论可持续发展
在第三学段 (5~6 年级)教学情境中
能识别工厂冒烟、森林被砍等破坏环境的行为, 并判断其是否利于可持续发展
能用 We should 接具体动作 (如 plant trees、use bikes、recycle) 表达解决办法
node.academic_req: 能在图片或生活情境中识别污染、砍伐等不可持续行为, 用 because 句型说出原因, 并用 We should 接具体动作提出解决办法。
node.assessment_prompt: 指着工厂冒烟的图片,{{name}}能不能用「This is bad」开头,并说出「because it pollutes the air」?接着让他提出办法,会不会用「We should」接具体动作,比如「plant trees」或「use bikes」?如果换成森林被砍的图片,他能不能照样说出问题加办法,不卡壳?\n如果{{name}}答不上来, 怎么提示?\n{{name}}能不能换一种说法解释?

node.teaching_activity: 准备 A4 海报纸、水彩笔、贴纸和「环保行动」单词卡 (plant trees / save water / pick up rubbish / use a reusable bag / turn off the lights) 共 5 组
node.teaching_voice: 我们来看,可持续发展就是让地球今天干净、明天也能用。想象你放学路上看见工厂冒黑烟,就要说'污染不好,我们 should plant trees and ride bikes'。记住,随手关水龙头、纸两面用,就是你能做的最大贡献。

exercises.question: Which picture shows something good for sustainable development?
exercises.explanation: 种树是有利于可持续发展的行为。A 工厂冒黑烟、B 砍伐森林、D 汽车尾气污染都破坏环境，不利于可持续发展。
options: A. A factory with black smoke.
B. People cutting down a forest.
C. People planting trees in a park.
D. Cars with dirty gas on the road.

exercises.question: To help the Earth, we should ____ more trees and ____ our rubbish instead of throwing it away.
exercises.explanation: plant trees（种树）和 recycle（回收利用）都是有利于可持续发展的具体行动，符合"We should + 动作"句型表达解决办法的要求。

exercises.question: Pollution from factories is bad. What should we do to help? Give two examples.
exercises.answer: We should ride bikes or take buses instead of cars. We should also plant more trees and turn off the water when we don't use it. Every small action helps keep the Earth clean for the future.
exercises.explanation: 1. 问题是否回应了工厂污染（提到减少污染/保护环境）。2. 是否用了 We should + 具体动作的句型。3. 是否给出 2 个具体、可行的例子（如 ride bikes、plant trees、recycle、save water 等）。

exercises.question: Look at the picture: a factory is putting black smoke into the sky, and many trees are being cut down near a village. (1) Is this good for sustainable development? Why? (2) What should people do to make it better? Please write 2-3 sentences using "We should ...".
exercises.answer:
审题: 判断图中的工厂冒黑烟和砍伐森林是否有利于可持续发展, 并给出解决办法。
分析: 工厂冒烟污染空气, 砍伐森林破坏生态, 都不利于可持续发展, 需要提出具体行动。
解答: No, it is not good for sustainable development. The smoke pollutes the air and cutting down trees destroys the forest. We should plant more trees and ride bikes instead of driving cars to keep our environment clean.
exercises.explanation:
1. 正确判断图中行为不利于可持续发展 (工厂冒烟 + 砍树均为破坏环境的行为)
2. 说明原因 (污染空气 / 破坏森林 / 不利于明天使用)
3. 用 We should 接具体动作 (plant trees / ride bikes / recycle 等) 提出解决办法, 句式完整

exercises.question: Your school is planning a "Green Week". Two ideas are given: Idea A — every student plants one tree on the playground. Idea B — every student brings a plastic bottle to recycle. (1) Which idea is better for sustainable development? Why? (2) Can the two ideas work together? Give one reason.
exercises.answer:
审题: 对比两种环保活动的效果, 选出更适合可持续发展的方案, 并说明能否结合。
分析: 可持续发展要求既改善生态又减少污染, plant trees 改善环境, recycle 减少垃圾, 二者方向不同但互补。
解答: I think Idea A is better, because planting trees can make the air cleaner and help the environment for a long time. Yes, they can work together. We can plant trees to make the school greener, and also recycle bottles to keep the school clean. Both ideas help our earth today and tomorrow.
exercises.explanation:
1. 能明确选出其中一个方案 (plant trees / recycle 任选, 言之有理即可)
2. 用本概念 (sustainable development — 让地球今天和明天都干净) 给出判断理由
3. 能说出两个方案可以结合, 并给出合理的跨方案解释 (植树 + 回收共同保护环境)
4. 语言表达连贯, 体现综合分析能力
